# Wrapper binaries built for every release target, one per line.
#
# Single source of truth for the release build, the release packaging step and
# the Windows CI job. It previously existed as three separate bash arrays that
# had to be kept identical by hand; a name added to one and missed in another
# silently ships a release with a wrapper the installer expects and cannot find.
#
# travsr-lang-objectivec is deliberately absent: it links libclang and shells
# out to xcrun, so it is built by its own macOS-only job. travsr's installer
# encodes the same exception (MACOS_ONLY_WRAPPERS) and its lang-release-drift
# check compares the two.
travsr-lang-c
travsr-lang-cpp
travsr-lang-csharp
travsr-lang-dart
travsr-lang-go
travsr-lang-java
travsr-lang-kotlin
travsr-lang-php
travsr-lang-python
travsr-lang-ruby
travsr-lang-scala
travsr-lang-swift
